svg.text: What it costs to launch 1 kW of always-on AI
Launched kg per continuous kW over 15 years, log scale. Grey band: GPUs in orbit (SpaceX AI1-class).
Benefit of the doubt: ideal receiver spacing, no clouds, dawn-dusk sun, no storage. Mirrors live 1 year (as filed).
